title: Boolean prefix parity
statement: For a Boolean word $w$ of length $m+2$ and a natural number $k$, define its prefix parity to be the sum in $mathbb{F}_2$ of the values corresponding to $w_i$ for $i<k$ and $i<m+2$; indices outside the word contribute zero.
